races.paceDynamic: No Knee Never appears to be the only genuine front-runner in this field, with most others happy to sit prominent or hold up. King Of Speed, Alazwar, Tam Lin and Showmedemoney will likely press but not lead, creating a steady tempo rather than fierce early pressure. The relatively soft pace should allow No Knee Never to dictate terms through honest fractions, with the large hold-up contingent including Little She, King Of The Dance, Chico Dulce and Rosemary's Rose tracking behind. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can control the tempo and kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If No Knee Never gets an easy lead with no serious early challengers
scenarios.body: The pace will be moderate allowing the leader to save energy for a strong finish, while the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from too far back. This setup perfectly suits a horse that can dictate terms from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Presser Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Speed or Alazwar press No Knee Never creating a stronger tempo
scenarios.body: The increased pace will soften up the leader while positioning the pressers perfectly to strike in the final furlong when stamina kicks in. This moderate pace increase still won't be fast enough to bring the hold-up horses into serious contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling slow early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole allowing the best finishers to unleash devastating late kicks from off the pace. Horses with proven finishing speed can overcome positional disadvantages in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to lead creating early speed before backing off dramatically
scenarios.body: The field bunches up entering the straight creating traffic problems and lucky passages determining the outcome more than ability. Late-running horses with room to maneuver gain significant advantages in the final 2f.

watchPoints.text: No Knee Never must be watched for how easily he gets to the lead - if unopposed he becomes very dangerous
Little She's 177-day absence is concerning but her hold-up style means she needs pace to aim at anyway
Multiple 7lb claiming jockeys could create inexperienced tactical decisions in running that affect the pace
Showmedemoney's recent course win makes him dangerous if getting the right prominent position
Watch for any late market moves on the long-absent runners Thursday and Snooker McCrew indicating hidden ability

runners_data.name: Twilight Jet

runners_data.name: Hoodie Hoo

races.paceDynamic: Dyrholaey will dictate from the front alongside fellow prominent runners Twilight Jet and Hoodie Hoo, creating a genuine pace test over this sharp 6f trip. With three horses committed to racing prominently, the early gallop will be testing but not suicidal, setting up a tactical battle from the 2f pole. The hold-up pair Dr Strangelove and Rare Change will need the pace to collapse late to be competitive. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position early and have the tactical speed to respond when the pace intensifies.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a strong but sustainable gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest enough to stretch the field but not collapse, allowing the best prominent racer to kick clear in the final furlong. Dyrholaey's recent consistent form at this trip and Twilight Jet's course experience become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: Dr Strangelove can unleash his finishing kick with Tom Marquand timing the run perfectly from the back. The 178-day break becomes an advantage rather than a concern if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Dyrholaey Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dyrholaey gets an uncontested lead with others sitting off
scenarios.body: Archie Watson's charge can dictate terms and prove too tough in a tactical finish. His recent form suggests he's ready for a bold front-running performance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hoodie Hoo Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the layoff doesn't impact Hoodie Hoo's sharpness significantly
scenarios.body: Charles Hills' runner can benefit from racing off the pace of Dyrholaey while having enough tactical speed to outfinish the hold-up horses. His best form came at this distance.

watchPoints.text: Dyrholaey getting too keen early and using up energy reserves before the business end of the race
Dr Strangelove's fitness levels after 178 days off despite having winning form fresh in the past
Twilight Jet's tendency to fade in the finish becoming pronounced if the pace is genuinely strong
Hoodie Hoo's sharpness returning from a winter break and whether 168 days affects his early positioning
The fractions through the first 2f determining whether this becomes a tactical affair or genuine speed test

races.paceDynamic: Rose Cotton and Phaedra will clash for the early lead in this fillies' handicap, with both confirmed front-runners likely to engage from the outset. Rose Cotton brings stronger recent form and Jack Mitchell's tactical awareness, while Phaedra offers more pace but inconsistent finishing. The dual pace engagement should create an honest gallop over 1m4f, stretching the field and potentially setting up the race for those with finishing kicks. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the early burn-up between the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Cotton and Phaedra duel too hard through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The sustained pace battle weakens both front-runners in the final quarter-mile, allowing the closers to sweep past. Hold-up specialists with proven finishing kicks benefit most from this collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Rose Cotton Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Cotton can dictate terms and see off Phaedra's early challenge
scenarios.body: Mitchell settles Rose Cotton into rhythm after repelling Phaedra, maintaining enough for the closing stages. Her recent Lingfield wins suggest she handles this track's demands well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is more moderate than expected
scenarios.body: A steadier gallop allows the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing speed, but without the pace collapse scenario. Twilight Moon's class and Hornby's timing become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Phaedra Surprise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Phaedra breaks clear early and maintains her advantage throughout
scenarios.body: The outsider gets an uncontested lead after Rose Cotton fails to engage properly, stealing crucial lengths. Finley Marsh's 7lb claim becomes significant in a competitive finish.

watchPoints.text: Rose Cotton and Phaedra's early battle intensity will determine whether leaders survive or collapse in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
